destinations.title: Join the library
destinations.summary: Sign up for a free library card.
descriptions: Get a library card so I can borrow books
Register as a new library member with proof of address

sections.label: Who can join
sections.body: Anyone who lives, works or studies in the borough can join the library for free.

sections.label: What to bring
sections.body: Bring a photo ID and one document showing your home address to get your card.

destinations.title: Renew a loan
descriptions: Extend the due date on my borrowed books
Renew library items online or by phone

sections.label: How to renew
sections.body: Renew online with your card number and PIN, by phone, or at the desk, up to three times.

sections.label: Late fees
sections.body: Overdue items cost ten pence a day, capped at five pounds per item.

destinations.title: Book a meeting room
destinations.summary: Reserve a study or meeting room.
descriptions: Reserve a quiet room to study or hold a meeting
Hire a room at the library for a group

sections.label: Room prices
sections.body: Study rooms are free for two hours; meeting rooms cost eight pounds an hour.

sections.label: Opening times
sections.body: Rooms can be booked from nine in the morning until six in the evening, Monday to Saturday.
